instructions: You see a fork in the path before you

left.instructions: You went left, and slipped on a banana.  Your knee hurts.  Your adventure is over

right.instructions: You went right.  There's never a wrong time to do the right thing.  You see three tunnels ahead of you.

tunnel_a.instructions: The tunnel is slimy, but it opens into a beautiful glade of elderberry bushes

eat_a_berry.instructions: Your tummy is now sick.  Your adventure is over

cut_down_a_bush.instructions: The bees attack you.  Your adventure is over

proceed_down_the_path.instructions: You found the prince/princess/pot of gold!  You won the adventure!

tunnel_b.instructions: You get stuck.  Your adventure is over

tunnel_c.instructions: You smell something bad but come to a dead end
